newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: KEPCO tenders to buy 748,000T Jan-Jun'97 fuel oil.
newsitem.headline: KEPCO tenders to buy 748,000T Jan-Jun'97 fuel oil.

text.p: The Korean Electric Power Corp (KEPCO) has issued a tender to buy a total of 748,000 tonnes of low sulphur fuel oil for delivery between January and June 1997, a company official said on Friday.
The tender sought up to two 75,000-tonne cargoes of 0.3 percent sulphur grade fuel oil for delivery to Ulsan, Pusan or Inchon each month.
The tender closes December 20 and offers are valid until December 23.

KEPCO had earlier awarded its tender to buy 2 million barrels of low sulphur waxy residue for January and February delivery at between $2.39 and $5.09 per barrel to LG-Caltex Oil Corp, a unit of LG Group, Daewoo Corp, a trading arm of Daewoo Group and Dutch Vitol.
